items.source: Note: This is an internal class and should not be used outside the framework.
items.translation: 注意： 这是一个内部类，不应在框架之外使用。

items.source: Thanks go to Marius Bogoevici for the initial implementation.
items.translation: 致谢归功于 Marius Bogoevici 的初始实现。

items.source: As of Spring 4.0, this class supports VFS 3.x on JBoss AS 6+ (package org.jboss.vfs) and is in particular compatible with JBoss AS 7 and WildFly 8+.
items.translation: 自 Spring 4.0 起，该类支持 JBoss AS 6+ 上的 VFS 3.x（包 `org.jboss.vfs`），特别是与 JBoss AS 7 和 WildFly 8+ 兼容。
